1. Add packages/runtime/src/agent/slice.ts exporting `capSlice(worktree, card): Promise<string[]>`. It starts from the card's source touches (reuse `sourceTouches` from judge/fast-path.ts) and drops any touch that is a test file (`*.test.*` or `*.spec.*`), so a test glob like `packages/**/*.test.ts` is never expanded. Expand the remaining source globs against the worktree and drop `isGeneratedPath` matches.

2. In slice.ts, for each touched source file, read it and collect its direct relative imports and re-exports (`import … from './x'`, `export … from '../y'`, dynamic `import('./z')`). Ignore any specifier that doesn't start with `.`, so bare packages are never followed. Resolve each one to an existing repo file, mapping `.js` to `.ts`/`.tsx`/`.mts`, trying the extension-less form and `index.*`. Go one level only: imported files are never scanned for their own imports.

3. In slice.ts, add the sibling test files of each touched source only: `<name>.test.<ext>`, `<name>.spec.<ext>`, and any `<name>*.test.<ext>` in the same directory that exists. Don't add tests for the imported files. Return README.md plus touches, imports and tests, deduplicated, sorted and with the CONTRACT_DOCS excluded.

4. In prompt.ts, replace the `sliceGlobs(card)` call in `assemblePrompt` with `capSlice(isolation.worktree, card)`, passed to packContext as literal paths. Keep `sliceGlobs` exported (index.ts re-exports it) but have it no longer expand test globs, or make it delegate to the same rules. Add `approxTokens: number` to `AssembledPrompt`, computed as `Math.ceil(prompt.length / 4)` over the full assembled prompt.

5. In build.ts, add an optional `maxTurns?: number` to `AgentCall`. In `claudeAgent`, append `--max-turns <n>` when it is set, and give plan mode `--permission-mode plan` alongside READ_ONLY_TOOLS. Add a `PLAN_TURNS = 4` constant and pass `maxTurns: PLAN_TURNS` on the plan call. The plan call already uses `assemblePrompt`, so it gets the same capped slice.

6. In build.ts, change the build-start ledger line to put the size before the file count, for example `· ~${planning.approxTokens} prompt tokens · ${planning.files.length} repo file(s) in context${usageNote(reply)}`. The `~N prompt tokens` wording keeps close.ts's USAGE_AT regex (`.* repo file\(s\) in context${USAGE}$`) matching and doesn't collide with the ` · N tokens` usage note. Give the fast-path build-start line the same treatment only if that is cheap; otherwise leave it.

Add a small unit test that `claudeAgent`'s argv construction includes `--max-turns 4` and `--permission-mode plan` for plan mode. If argv isn't reachable, extract a pure `agentArgs(call)` helper in build.ts and test that.

9. Run `pnpm vitest related --run packages/runtime/src/agent/slice.ts packages/runtime/src/agent/prompt.ts packages/runtime/src/agent/build.ts packages/runtime/src/agent/slice-cap.test.ts` and fix failures. Check that the existing agent.test.ts (`### src/total.ts` in the prompt) and the ship.test.ts ledger expectations still pass unchanged. Then run `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run lint`, and make sure no new code comments or suppressions were added.
